Sau khi được duyệt, đăng báo cáo lên kênh #weekly và lưu một bản vào thư mục Drive của dự án.

proposal.name: weekly-progress-report
proposal.when: viết báo cáo tiến độ hằng tuần (weekly progress report)
proposal.steps: Open the current sprint's Jira board and filter tickets closed this week, noting the count, each ticket and its owner. List unfinished work with the reason for the delay and the expected date. Note new risks and who needs help. Send the draft to the team lead for approval before posting. Once approved, post it to #weekly and save a copy in the project's Drive folder.
